notes: NovaShell 130 restores clear, controller-aware movement guidance, reliable keyboard focus, and direct access to every NovaShell World room.
changes: NovaShell World now shows one small, readable bottom control dock that automatically changes from WASD/arrow instructions to Xbox left-stick, A, and B instructions when a controller is present.
NovaShell World reacquires keyboard focus after a tap, window focus, or return to the tab. Escape/B now closes a station panel, while Shift/RT is the optional faster walk modifier.

The World has broad physical doorways between its four rooms; a movement-path check now reaches every room directly from spawn instead of trapping right-side destinations behind a long central collision wall.
Every local user-app launch now includes an automatic folder revision, so updated HTML, styles, and modules receive a fresh launch URL instead of reusing a stale PWA or iframe response.
NovaShell World now has no header, room status, proximity prompt, or renderer-made floating text at all; those elements were removed from the markup and renderer rather than merely hidden.
NovaShell World's intentional interaction panel now uses explicit high-contrast text in every theme, including Ultra Retro.
Maker Desk is now NovaShell World's real local setup editor: choose room finishes and up to eight owned-game arcade cabinets, save locally, then enter the building with that setup applied.
NovaShell World no longer keeps developer-style labels, prompts, or a status HUD on top of the building; only an intentional station interaction opens a readable panel.
NovaShell World keeps filtered 3D labels out of the way, moves station names into readable interaction panels, and makes Orbit and every external surface an explicit optional choice.
NovaShell World now has a low-key positional room tone that grows and pans as you approach the Orbit speaker after a user interaction enables sound.
Theme changes now synchronize through settings, the desktop, open panels, and Orbit even when the setting changes in a separate same-origin window.

GBA multiplayer now describes mGBA's real link flow honestly: NovaShell opens the first game and mGBA's New Multiplayer Window creates the link, rather than pretending two unrelated CLI windows are linked.
NovaShell World now takes WASD and arrow-key input through both code and key fallbacks, focuses its canvas on launch, prevents page-scroll key loss, and uses larger high-contrast labels.
Pocket Archive and all eleven bundled local apps received a clean runtime and interaction smoke pass; a real GBA game now reaches a live EmulatorJS canvas again.

If Chrome displays a cached NovaShell shell while the local helper is stopped, the desktop now explains exactly why games, apps, files, and local tools cannot work and provides the one-line restart command.
The normal Chromebook launcher now opens the correct 127.0.0.1 NovaShell address with a cache-busting launch URL.
Selective restore now previews new files, conflicts, preserved entries, blocked archive entries, exact group samples, and replacement safety copies before extracting anything.
A changed backup or destination invalidates the reviewed restore fingerprint, so it must be inspected again before a write occurs.
Every shared Retro window now has one consistent draggable title bar and a larger touch-safe close target instead of overlapping duplicate close controls.
Every built-in NovaShell app now inherits one centered, touch-sized Back control, including apps that previously had a mismatched link or no Back control.
Orbit's compact player now recovers unsupported and stale visual states instead of occasionally showing a blank canvas.
The top-left signal beacon now uses matching loop endpoints for fluid motion without a visible restart seam.
Retro Settings adds sixteen original CSS-only mixed-color pattern wallpapers that remain fast and offline.
Relay's Second Brain, provider routes, guarded core workspace, Web Component app workshop, and local action history now load together as one visible harness.
Generated apps use a review-only sandbox preview, an explicit CREATE APP confirmation, a four-file module layout, and a local plan-preview-confirm-result ledger.
N64 versus launch now confirms Chrome sees two distinct controllers before starting and clearly shows whether player two is ready.
Storage details now include a read-only cleanup and recovery coach for stale Downloads, recoverable Trash, and the last completed selective backup.
Backup completion state is stored only in ignored local data and never includes credentials or file contents.
Hosted NovaShell now includes Retro/Cobalt, touch/controller navigation, explicit IndexedDB game selection, Orbit, Notes, Kanban, Weather, Browse, Relay guidance, and browser backup.
Public docs and the parity matrix now identify exactly which hosted features work and which still require local NovaShell.
Show large files, open my music folder, and back up game saves now resolve to explicit NovaShell routes instead of falling through as unknown text.
Sensitive-looking intents show a controller-compatible preview stating what data is read and confirming that no file or backup changes happen automatically.
The import screen now has one transaction owner and sends the required catalog key and source path after a local ROM copy.
Existing owned games update their private card without overwriting existing artwork, and interrupted metadata appears in the review queue rather than vanishing.
Manage local games now has All, Needs details, and Multiplayer queues plus search, location identity, a consistent editor window, and owner-art replacement with ignored local backups.
Weather Station now uses one self-contained modular runtime instead of layered legacy scripts and styles.
Forecast URLs can specify a place, public captures skip private local defaults, and the last successful report remains usable when weather sources are offline.
Xbox pads are sorted by physical browser index and assigned independently to player one through player four, including controllers exposed after the emulator starts.
N64 fighter detection now includes Mortal Kombat, Killer Instinct, ClayFighter, Fighter's Destiny, Mace, War Gods, Dark Rift, and other local-versus titles.
The full EmulatorJS map now includes both analog sticks, triggers, D-pad, face buttons, shoulders, and stick clicks.
N64 games marked multiplayer—and known local-versus classics—show a direct two-player launch in their game sheet.
Rail Finder now has a private-key CTA departure and arrival board, and Reset Station has expanded breathing and recovery routines.
NovaShell World now uses a low-resolution multi-room pixel building with real local stations.
